rule.name: FirstElementOfMaybeEmpty
rule.message: The first element is read after only a null check. A value that is not null can still be empty: a parser result, a header list or a query returns an empty list, array or string, and get(0), [0], charAt(0) or iterator().next() then throws IndexOutOfBoundsException, ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, StringIndexOutOfBoundsException or NoSuchElementException on that one input. Test emptiness instead of, or as well as, null: if (init != null && !init.isEmpty()), values.length > 0 && values[0] == LIMIT, !text.isEmpty() && text.charAt(0) == '#'. Right code is not reported: a method that tests the value's emptiness, length, size or content anywhere (isEmpty, size, length, startsWith or equals with a literal, a for-each over it), a value built in the method (List.of, an array literal), and a read inside a loop.
